name: 86001 · Flagstaff, AZ
findings: ZIP 86001 (Flagstaff) has 176 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 86001 (Flagstaff) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
